ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

2. Which response best shows understanding of Shariah religion intellect life property dignity? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Shariah religion intellect life property dignity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Shariah religion intellect life property dignity.
   C. Say Shariah religion intellect life property dignity has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Shariah religion intellect life property dignity to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith.
   D. Use Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Tawbah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Tawbah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawbah.
   C. Say Tawbah has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Tawbah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in the Last Day Hellfire? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in the Last Day Hellfire to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in the Last Day Hellfire.
   C. Say Belief in the Last Day Hellfire has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in the Last Day Hellfire with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

7. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Use Virtues in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues in Islam.
   C. Say Virtues in Islam has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Virtues in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat.
   D. Use Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives? (1 mark)

11. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an? (1 mark)

12. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

13. Which response best shows understanding of Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06 ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Domestic violence 06 6.2 Iddah 05 6.3 Child custody 04 6.4 Polygamy in Islam 06 .

14. Which response best shows understanding of Prohibitions in Islam Zina? (1 mark)

----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
